snapshot.title: History extras: version diff/restore and MCP push notifications
snapshot.description:
Step 6 of the build order.

- Versions: diff any two snapshots of an item, and restore an earlier version as a new revision (RestoreVersion, user only, `CHANGE_TYPE_RESTORED`).
- History in the GUI: the change log and decision notes per item.
- MCP resource-update notifications for clients that subscribe (Requirements.md, Agent Interaction → Staleness). Optional; the revision check stays the guarantee.
